items.name: list
items.behavior: List bundled CW workflows.

items.name: search
items.behavior: Search workflow apps by keyword (title, description, id).

items.name: info
items.behavior: Show what a workflow app does: title, description, inputs, sandbox, phases, and a runnable example.

items.name: init
items.behavior: Scaffold a new workflow definition.

items.name: plan
items.behavior: Create a CW run and return its canonical plan summary.

items.name: status
items.behavior: Read run checkpoint status.

items.name: next
items.behavior: Read the next recommended tasks for a run.

items.name: dispatch
items.behavior: Create a subagent dispatch manifest.

items.name: result
items.behavior: Record a subagent result file against a task.

items.name: state
items.behavior: Group; sub: check — check run-state schema compatibility.

items.name: commit
items.behavior: Create a verifier-gated commit or checkpoint; sub: summary reads the structured commit summary.

items.name: report
items.behavior: Render a run report; subs: bundle (sealed portable bundle, self-verified), verify-bundle (offline verify).

items.name: app
items.behavior: Group; subs: init, list, package, run, show, validate — manage CW workflow apps.

items.name: sandbox
items.behavior: Group; subs: choose, list, resolve (alias of choose), show, validate — sandbox profiles.

items.name: backend
items.behavior: Group; subs: agent config (show + set forms), list, probe, show — execution backends.

items.name: contract
items.behavior: Sub: show — show a run's pipeline contract.

items.name: node
items.behavior: Group; subs: diff, graph, list, replay, show, snapshot, verify — state nodes.

items.name: feedback
items.behavior: Group; subs: collect, list, resolve, show, summary, task — run feedback records.

items.name: worker
items.behavior: Group; subs: fail, list, manifest, output, show, summary, validate — worker isolation scopes.

items.name: audit
items.behavior: Group; subs: attest, blackboard, decision, judge, multi-agent, policy, provenance, role, summary, verify, worker — trust/audit reads and records.

items.name: candidate
items.behavior: Group; subs: list, rank, register, reject, score, select, show, summary — candidates for a run.

items.name: review
items.behavior: Group; subs: policy (set review-gate policy), status (derived per-target review state).

items.name: loop
items.behavior: Create a recurring loop schedule.

items.name: schedule
items.behavior: Group; subs: complete, create, daemon, delete, due, history, list, pause, resume, run-now — scheduled CW tasks.

items.name: routine
items.behavior: Group; subs: create, delete, events, fire, list — routine-style API/GitHub triggers.

items.name: registry
items.behavior: Group; subs: refresh, show — derived run registry index with valid|stale|absent freshness.

items.name: run
items.behavior: Group; subs: archive, drive (preview + drive forms), export, import, inspect-archive, list, rerun, restore, resume, search, show, verify-import — run lifecycle across repos.

items.name: queue
items.behavior: Group; subs: add, drain, list, show — durable run queue.

items.name: clones
items.behavior: Group; subs: gc (TTL sweep of clones cache), list (read-only) — cached remote-source checkouts.

items.name: orphans
items.behavior: Group; subs: gc (age sweep), list (read-only) — run dirs under .cw/runs/ with no state.json.

items.name: history
items.behavior: Read a cross-repo unified run timeline (newest first).

items.name: quickstart
items.behavior: ONE-COMMAND quickstart: plan -> run --drive -> report in one invocation; --check, --preview, --bundle modes.

items.name: audit-run
items.behavior: Hidden alias of quickstart (same case in src/cli/command-surface.ts); 'help audit-run' prints 'Unknown command' with exit 0.

items.name: multi-agent
items.behavior: Group; subs: blackboard, dependencies, evidence, failures, fanin (x2), fanout (x2), graph (x2), group (x2), membership (x2), reasoning (x2), role (x2), run (x3), score, select, show, status, step, summarize, summary — multi-agent runtime.

items.name: topology
items.behavior: Group; subs: apply, graph, list, show, summary, validate — topology definitions and runs.

items.name: summary
items.behavior: Group; subs: refresh, show — state-explosion summaries.

items.name: blackboard
items.behavior: Group; subs: artifact add|list, context put, graph, message list|post, resolve, snapshot, summarize, summary, topic create — run blackboard.

items.name: coordinator
items.behavior: Group; subs: decision, summary — coordinator decisions.

items.name: metrics
items.behavior: Group; subs: show (per-run observability + attested-cost report), summary (cross-repo rollup).

items.name: operator
items.behavior: Group; subs: report, status — structured Operator UX views.

items.name: sched
items.behavior: Group; subs: complete, lease, plan, policy (show + set forms), reclaim, release, reset — queue lease scheduling.

items.name: gc
items.behavior: Group; subs: plan (dry-run), run (write-ahead reclamation transaction), verify — run reclamation.

items.name: telemetry
items.behavior: Sub: verify — re-prove a run's telemetry attestation ledger offline (chain + optional ed25519 pubkey check).

items.name: migration
items.behavior: Group; subs: check, list, prove — migration registry and proofs.

items.name: demo
items.behavior: Group; subs: bundle, tamper — self-contained tamper-evidence demos.

items.name: workbench
items.behavior: Group; subs: serve (localhost-only read-only host), view (five-panel run view).

items.name: approve
items.behavior: Append a host-attested approval of a candidate/commit/selection.

items.name: reject
items.behavior: Append a host-attested rejection (blocking veto) of a candidate/commit/selection.

items.name: comment
items.behavior: Group; subs: add, list — append-only comments on durable targets.

items.name: handoff
items.behavior: Record an ownership transfer (from-actor to to-actor) of a run/task.

items.name: ledger
items.behavior: Group; subs: apply, list, propose, review, verify — verifiable cross-agent ledger entries (fail-closed).

items.name: graph
items.behavior: Read the structured Operator UX run graph.

items.name: eval
items.behavior: Group; subs: compare, gate, replay, report, score, snapshot — eval/replay regression tooling.

items.name: man
items.behavior: Show a man page from docs/ (e.g. cw man release-tooling); with no topic exits 1 with 'cw: Missing topic.' on stderr.

items.name: doctor
items.behavior: Diagnose the host for setup problems (Node version, agent backend, agent binary, git, writable home/repo state); --json gives a schemaVersion 1 checks object.

items.name: version
items.behavior: Print the current cool-workflow version (plain text; --json changes nothing).

items.name: update
items.behavior: Update cool-workflow to the latest release via npm (help captured only; never run).

items.name: fix
items.behavior: Print consolidated fix commands for CW setup issues.

items.name: help
items.behavior: Print the human CLI help text; 'help <cmd>' prints one command's subcommand table; unknown words exit 0 with a suggestion; --help is a byte-alias.
